sentences.text:
Counsel for Respondent :- G.A.,Abhishek Hon'ble Vivek Kumar Birla,J.
Hon'ble Kshitij Shailendra,J.
No one has put in appearance on behalf of the petitioners even in the revised call.

This writ petition has been filed with the following prayers:-
"(A) Issue a writ, order or direction in the nature of Certiorari for quashing the impugned F.I.R. dated 05.07.2021 registered as Case Crime No. 0063 of 2021, under Sections 498A, 354, 307, 323, 504, 506 I.P.C. and Section 3/4 D.P. Act, P.S.- Mahila Thana, District- Meerut.
Ashwani And 3 Others vs State Of U.P. And 3 Others on 16 February, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/45995845/
1 (B) Issue a writ, order or direction in the nature of Mandamus commanding the respondents to not to arrest the petitioner in Case Crime No. 0063 of 2021, under Sections 498A, 354, 307, 323, 504, 506 I.P.C. and Section 3/4 D.P. Act, P.S.- Mahila Thana, District- Meerut, during the pendency of present writ petition before this Hon'ble Court."
Interim order, if any, stands vacated.
Present petition is accordingly dismissed for want of prosecution.
